polygon-clipping 0.15.7 — MIT, Mike Fogel and contributors.

Pinned browser/CommonJS build from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/polygon-clipping@0.15.7/dist/polygon-clipping.umd.min.js

Upstream: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping
Licence: polygon-clipping.LICENSE.md

Used only for real building/boundary polygon intersection and tile-fragment union.
MapLibre's `within` expression does not support polygon building features. The
vendored helper is about 29 KB uncompressed; no package manager or build is required.
